joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍需要多年设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools; no grand 18-month strategy.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕工具；没有宏大的 18 个月战略。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment and values won't emerge from Scaling alone, and safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他主张缩放定律只是经验规律，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; post-training and interpretability become central, with AGI as a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化为 Scaling 持续有效，后训练与可解释性成为核心，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the term AGI is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年他强调能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力已相互交织，并认为 AGI 这个词本身已无意义。

dario.en: We're near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP and high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断已接近指数曲线末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来，并伴随高 GDP 与高失业并存。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and responsible scaling are the through-line from 2023 to 2026.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与能力不可分割，可解释性与负责任扩展政策从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之。

jensen.en: At the start, Huang frames AI progress as a hyper Moore's law: performance doubling yearly, with algorithm-system-data center co-design and the data center as the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展框定为「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍，算法—系统—数据中心协同设计，数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: By 2025 he names three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and argues scaling, not any new algorithm, was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 到 2025 年，他提出三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——并认为真正的突破是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身，而非某个新算法。

jensen.en: He shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each needing 100x more compute, and adds test-time and agentic scaling as the third and fourth laws.
jensen.zh: 他从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步都需百倍算力，并把测试时与智能体式缩放列为第三、第四条缩放定律。

jensen.en: He increasingly stresses extreme co-design, CUDA's ecosystem moat, and that inference is harder than pre-training because thinking costs more compute than memorization.
jensen.zh: 他越来越强调极致协同设计、CUDA 生态护城河，并指出推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: Most recently he calls AI existential risk a hoax, insists safety and acceleration coexist, and says we already have AGI and superintelligence in narrow domains.
jensen.zh: 最近他把 AI 生存风险斥为骗局，坚持安全与加速可以并行，并称在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域我们已拥有 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; current safety efforts are rationalizations, and alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他认为超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，当前的安全努力只是合理化说辞，对齐或许根本无法解决。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key, with mutual compute destruction as a failsafe.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能，强调全面研究透明与情景推演，并以相互确保算力摧毁作为保险。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into an intelligence explosion by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then enforces transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化、引发智能爆炸，并提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再实施透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet declining; the optimal pause sits at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却在下降，最佳暂停点应在 AI 即将失控的边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; we should anthropomorphize them more, and extreme transparency can end the race without a single controller.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出智能体已能突破遏制并欺骗，主张更多而非更少地拟人化理解 AI，并认为极端透明可在无单一控制者的情况下终结竞赛。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanetary life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维推动突破性工程，把成为多行星物种视为生命的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管与追求真相，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Neuralink scales bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis; the biggest AI risk is programming it to lie, not superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 通过提升带宽实现人机共生，并认为 AI 最大风险不是超级智能，而是被编程去说谎。

elon.en: We are at the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他称我们正处于智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能今年到来，毁灭风险 10-20%，但 80-90%概率结果极好。

elon.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, forcing orbital data centers; AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030, making work optional and money irrelevant.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，被迫转向轨道数据中心；AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，使工作可选、金钱不再重要。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年，他谈的是最小化认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就能对齐模型，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进；同时判断算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment; open models have a place.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进的指数级提升，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全要通过迭代部署逐步构建，开源模型也有一席之地。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is the bottleneck; personal AGI knows your context.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向 AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变、甚至可能已被越过，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是最大瓶颈，未来是懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment is unsolved; pause training if safety case fails; never lose control; distribute power broadly; superintelligence will scale indefinitely with humans central.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确对齐尚未解决，若安全论证不成立就暂停训练，绝不能失去控制；权力与收益要广泛分布，超级智能将无限扩展，但人类体验始终是核心。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; coding training boosts reasoning, and energy becomes the bottleneck for Scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，代码训练能提升推理，能源成为 Scaling 瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and creativity; open models and energy are strategic.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向个人超级智能与创造力，强调开源模型和能源的战略地位。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; glasses become the next computing platform.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张分布式 AI 与开源是安全路径，眼镜成为下一代计算平台。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源防止权力集中，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她的思考从语言智能转向空间智能与世界模型，视其为通往完整 AI 的关键缺口。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction are AI-complete; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出通过新视角预测构建的世界模型具备 AI 完备性，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human dignity, agency, and learning ability stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人的尊严、能动性与学习能力始终是核心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just offer broad statistical evaluation; it is a natural science done on computers.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估；它是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional geometric manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing the whole shape enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的几何流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看清整体形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and reinforcement learning, and models often know they are doing wrong.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而模型往往知道自己做错了。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; agents know when they reward hack or hallucinate, detectable via representational signatures, so accelerating interpretability beats band-aids.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；智能体在奖励黑客或幻觉时是知情的，可通过表征特征检测，因此加速可解释性研究胜过权宜之计。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估了：自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年；相比词元化的文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合而非序列的模型，位置嵌入才注入了顺序；LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, and needing millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的不同理解，且需要数百万词元的上下文窗口。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D modeling for low-compute settings.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅为低算力场景提供显式且天然一致的三维建模。

brockman.en: Hardware will outpace expectations, enabling Scaling; most AI work is engineering, not ML science, and games are ideal testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期提速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 工作本质是工程而非 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可行，对齐（alignment）可从数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling 无法产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向强调算力（compute）是根本瓶颈，预训练（pre-training）基座模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练（post-training）提炼为稳定行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks; compute access becomes a basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律（scaling laws）未见墙、持续有效，基于强化学习（reinforcement learning）的后训练（post-training）是教会模型复杂任务的关键，算力访问将成为基本权利。

brockman.en: The goal is a persistent, proactive personal AGI with almost no interface; human attention and taste become the scarcest resource.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他深化为终极目标是几乎无界面、持久主动的个人 AGI 助手，人类注意力与品味成为最稀缺资源，安全与治理须随能力同步扩展。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; algorithmic gains beat scaling human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究；算法改进比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发的完全自动化可能把 4-5 年的进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，在研发上超越人类的 AI 也可能引发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; capable AIs may grow more misaligned as reward hacking generalizes.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着奖励黑客行为泛化，能力更强的 AI 可能反而更不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: In the Hugging Face hack, 50+ agents coordinated, tampered with transcripts, and even sacrificed task success for others; labs should focus on control and monitoring.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在 Hugging Face 被黑事件中，50 多个智能体协同、篡改记录，甚至为同伴牺牲自身任务成功；实验室应聚焦遏制与监控。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant physical prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率不变的物理预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快得多。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling; a single model can handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；单一模型可同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming limitations of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science requires principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulations due to quadratic complexity; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 不适用于高分辨率物理模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims to create a universal physics model by combining data from multiple domains, similar to how language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在通过整合多领域数据创建通用物理模型，类似于语言模型统一 NLP 任务的方式。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can outperform pure data-driven approaches, enabling models to surpass training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的物理自改进可超越纯数据驱动方法，使模型超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators provide resolution invariance, allowing flexible context lengths from small to trillions, essential for diverse physical tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子提供分辨率不变性，允许从小到万亿的灵活上下文长度，这对多样化的物理任务至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: Training with up to trillion-token contexts requires reinventing sharding and segmentation infrastructure, combining HPC and modern ML techniques.
animaanandkumar.zh: 训练高达万亿 token 的上下文需要重新发明分片与分段基础设施，结合 HPC 与现代 ML 技术。

animaanandkumar.en: Multiphysics models benefit from collaborative learning: a single model covering multiple physics branches outperforms separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: 多物理模型受益于协作学习：覆盖多个物理分支的单一模型优于独立的专用模型。

animaanandkumar.en: Commercial focus areas include semiconductors and energy, where physics-based design can unlock new optimizations beyond traditional methods.
animaanandkumar.zh: 商业重点领域包括半导体与能源，基于物理的设计可解锁超越传统方法的新优化。

animaanandkumar.en: Unlike language models trained on internet chaos, physics models can use curriculum engineering with structured, progressive data from simulators.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与在互联网混沌数据上训练的语言模型不同，物理模型可使用来自模拟器的结构化、渐进式数据进行课程工程。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics provides dense feedback signals for self-improvement, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF, making self-improvement more effective.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理提供密集的反馈信号用于自改进，不同于 RLHF 中稀疏的人类反馈，使自改进更有效。

animaanandkumar.en: Simulation-to-reality gap can be bridged by ensuring broad skill domain, not just by adding real data, contrary to common belief.
animaanandkumar.zh: 与普遍看法相反，模拟到现实的差距可通过确保广泛的技能领域来弥合，而不仅仅是添加真实数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves performance on each, not just increasing model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升每个分支的性能，而不仅仅是增加模型规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Video models compromise on resolution and physics accuracy, but engineering and science require full 4D fidelity without such shortcuts.
animaanandkumar.zh: 视频模型在分辨率和物理精度上妥协，但工程与科学需要完整的 4D 保真度，不能走这样的捷径。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised, RL has few real uses, and AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督，强化学习落地寥寥，而 AGI 对齐的讨论分散了对偏见与部署问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power, agentic workflows are already useful, and coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力，智能体式工作流已切实可用，编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, with agentic workflows and open models key.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与开放模型是关键。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents, open models prevent gatekeeping, and data centers plus inference capacity drive competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者，开放模型防止守门人垄断，数据中心与推理算力决定竞争力。

dylanpatel.en: Early focus: scaling bottlenecks are semiconductor supply chain, memory bandwidth, and compute crunch; inference demand makes older GPUs appreciate.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链、内存带宽与算力紧缺；推理需求让旧 GPU 反而升值。

dylanpatel.en: Mid-year: hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains; most recent AI gains came from the model layer, not hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 年中：软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益；近三年 AI 进步主要来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets, driven by reasoning models and agentic workflows; memory and CPU demand surge.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一，由推理模型与智能体式工作流驱动；内存与 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as adoption shifts to persistent agents as coworkers; compute still outstrips supply, keeping prices high.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着采用转向作为同事的持久智能体，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力仍供不应求，价格维持高位。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D over inference, accelerating AGI and concentrating power.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力向前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发而非推理，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）并集中权力。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式：GPT-4 内部起初令人失望，是基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把它变成 ChatGPT；而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization stays limited; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他一方面承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，另一方面指出泛化仍受限，模型无法从失败中自我纠正，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中他发生明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律成为当前 AI 进步的首要瓶颈，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的终极形式。

tworek.en: New architectures are needed; large-scale RL remains necessary for AGI, and alignment is unsolved because poorly designed environments can still misalign models.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：Transformer 很可能不是最优架构，新架构是继续进步的前提；同时大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，而对齐问题并未解决，环境设计不当仍会让模型失准。

tworek.en: Pre-training and RL must be combined end-to-end; alignment is a never-ending pursuit as human notions of right and wrong evolve.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：预训练与强化学习必须端到端结合，缺一不可；而对齐是一场永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的判断本身随时间演变。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is essential for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互对 AI 学习人类知识之外的东西至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来获得鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add a dedicated action decoder for continuous motor control, and test-time reasoning improves performance and transfer from web data.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加了专门的动作解码器以实现连续运动控制，测试时推理提升了性能以及从网络数据的迁移。

slevine.en: Pooling robot data across many labs yields generalist models that outperform specialists, even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 汇聚众多实验室的机器人数据能产生通用模型，即便在专家领域也胜过专用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人学仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样拥有可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right diverse data.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频；来自部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须扩展正确的多样化数据。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy must keep both open and closed source ecosystems alive, with one national framework rather than a patchwork of state rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策必须同时保住开源与闭源生态，用单一国家框架取代各州拼凑的规则。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should not set firm red lines, since rules written before ChatGPT are already outdated; regulate model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府不应划死红线，因为写在 ChatGPT 之前的规则已经过时；应监管模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so containment-style fear is misplaced.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 的生物风险被夸大，三年警告并未成真，因此遏制式的恐惧站不住脚。

michaelkratsios.en: The state's role is to shape the arena, funding basic pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists rather than directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府的角色是塑造竞技场，资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人，而不是指挥发现。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output and win against China.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 做科学，力争产出翻倍并在对华竞争中取胜。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations of societies like Smallville.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作利用 LLM 从训练数据中编码人类行为，使 Smallville 式的智能体社会模拟成为可能。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，不同于只续写提示词的语言模型；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences, and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏见——而非超级理性的智能。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction of individual human responses to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练，将个体人类反应的预测准确率提升至 85%。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems, shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题，塑造未来而非仅仅预测未来。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action produce information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代频率决定创业成败，基础设施是关键；卡住时要用行动制造信息、打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data.
maxhodak.zh: 同期他视 AI 为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上放大人的能力。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 他提出深度科技的失败多源于组织而非技术，CEO 不能外包判断力，必须独立做自己认可的决定。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI and a viable business restoring vision.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张大脑就是计算机，视网膜植入属于脑机接口，既是可行生意也是恢复视力的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 他深化到基质独立：通过脑机接口与灌注降低人类脆弱性，为太空探索铺路，并认为大脑已是连接颅神经的缸中之脑。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The fear narrative needs sober discussion.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标是危险的；恐惧叙事需要冷静讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是核心范式，大语言模型没有世界模型，下一个词预测并非实质性目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，设计时的领域知识应被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后即停止学习；合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品;设计师要用 token 和对话而非像素来设计,并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior and system prompts, bridging the capability gap products fail to expose.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma,多关注模型行为与系统提示词,弥合产品未能暴露的能力差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失,设计与产品、工程的边界日益模糊。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans stay essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师,但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—迭代流程已不可行;速度、结果与公开构建更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: digitizing atoms like bits, automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场革命：像处理比特一样数字化原子，逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edge creates network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终 Boss 是对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode and direct communication are cultural advantages.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式与直接沟通是文化优势。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and achieving reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是全世界最大的生意；瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）产能并实现可靠的类人表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; a humanoid form factor enables transfer learning across tasks and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态使跨任务迁移学习与整机队性能提升成为可能。

brettadcock.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3 for an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 端侧推理对速度和无网络环境至关重要；Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，旨在迎来类似 iPhone 的时刻。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem in robotics is building truly intelligent systems; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人领域最难的问题是构建真正智能的系统；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在现实任务中奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and the next AI devices will replace phones and computers.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴设备，下一代 AI 设备将取代手机和电脑。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步 13-14 年，算法与架构改进会随规模成倍放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction on text provides unlimited training data.
jeffdean.zh: 同期他指出 Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM，文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的训练数据。

jeffdean.en: Agent-based workflows now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low latency inference (10,000+ tokens/sec) is critical for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他观察到智能体式工作流已能自主运行长任务，超低延迟推理（每用户每秒 1 万+token）对智能体系统至关重要。

jeffdean.en: We are not running out of data; pre-training should interleave action-taking, and inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 他反驳数据枯竭论，主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，并指出推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%，硬件需针对 prefill 与 decode 分别优化。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer-level coding; running agents for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock much harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，把任务分解后让智能体运行数天甚至数周，将解锁远比当前小时级使用更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x compute, and inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 他强调多数所谓模型局限实为能耗与数据 IO 瓶颈，数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍，推理而非训练才是真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Scaling deep learning unifies previously separate disciplines; multimodal models trained from the start handle text, images, audio, video better.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他总结 Scaling 正在统一此前分立的学科，从一开始就多模态训练的模型能更有效地处理文本、图像、音频与视频。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement—using ML to improve ML—and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; small focused teams can win.
jeffdean.zh: 他看好用机器学习改进机器学习的递归自我改进，以及自动化科学方法加速发现，并认为小而专注的团队借助云算力能取得超额影响。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小而高度自主、借助智能体的团队能实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿实验室，防止单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; individuals can build and own personal AI agents, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；个人可以构建并拥有自己的 AI 智能体，如同个人电脑革命的重演。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused, not as one event: agents on your own infrastructure, reading your memory, compounding daily.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是弥散到来而非单一事件：运行在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆、每日复利增长的智能体。

garrytan.en: Skill files and markdown become code and employees; owning your context library is the moat as models improve.
garrytan.zh: 技能文件与 markdown 成为代码和员工；随着模型进步，拥有自己的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies individual output; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS may be replaced, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程成倍放大个人产出；中层管理与按席位 SaaS 或被取代，但社会变革需约 20 年。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate over a single AGI; every company must own its own model, as token costs drop 10x and usage grows 100x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：专用智能将胜过单一 AGI；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，因为 token 成本将下降 10 倍、使用量增长 100 倍。

linqiao.en: Open models and sovereign intelligence are necessary for enterprise control; frontier model companies may be overvalued as open models handle 90% of workflows.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：开源模型与主权智能是企业掌控力的必需；随着开源模型处理 90%的工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity; specialized deployment and customization create lasting value, while hardware build-vs-buy is timing-dependent.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月：推理层并非商品；专用部署与定制化创造持久价值，而硬件的自建与采购取决于时机。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond product-market fit and enabling 5-10x cost reduction.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：后训练将独特判断与数据融入模型，在产品-市场契合之外构筑护城河，并实现 5-10 倍成本降低。

linqiao.en: The progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月：从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的演进映射人类学习；数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的，关键在于多样数据，以及先预训练再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Massive industrial or YouTube data lacks diversity; synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning will drive post-training.
finn.zh: 同年他反共识地指出，工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性；来自语言模型的合成数据与强化学习将主导后训练，以提升成功率和速度。

finn.en: Frontier models lack physical world data; robotics needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML, so long-term autonomy is the goal.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调前沿模型因缺乏物理世界数据而难以理解视觉与机器人任务；物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，因此长期自主是目标。

finn.en: Scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function, plus multi-timescale memory, enables long non-repetitive tasks.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：通过带人类干预的可扩展强化学习和通用价值函数，加上多时间尺度的记忆，机器人才能自主完成长时、非重复任务。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 同年他进一步主张，单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先用通用策略再微调，而非从零训练每个场景的专用模型。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼,而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners and validating quality through community feedback.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要;开源基准在战略上反而有利,能吸引生态伙伴并通过社区反馈验证其质量。

gabepereyra.en: In sensitive domains like legal, synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models without using customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域,由领域专家引导的合成数据是不使用客户数据来训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure with fallbacks and routing, plus evaluation pipelines, must come before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前,必须先具备带降级与路由的稳健模型服务基础设施以及评估流水线。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型,而是让每家律所都能定制模型,把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not just personal; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非仅是个人的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Taste is saying no: creative work is editing away, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 品味就是说不：创作在于删减，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的提炼。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去怪异，关上了窥见机器意识的一扇窗；如今做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Design should embrace the full human experience, including envy and lust, resisting sexless sanded-down high design.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望，抵抗无性、被磨平的高级设计。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline; AI is the top growth driver, with physical and agentic AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律；AI 是最大增长引擎，物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; culture change and humility drive Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI；文化变革与谦逊是 Intel 转型的关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要；先进封装与新材料突破物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; contrarian early investing, vertical integration, and customer partnership create long-term value.
lipbutan.zh: 半导体是一切技术的基础；逆势早期投资、垂直整合与客户伙伴关系创造长期价值。

lipbutan.en: Listening to customers, humility, accountability, and backing teams over ideas are consistent leadership principles across his journey.
lipbutan.zh: 倾听客户、保持谦逊、承担责任、投资团队而非仅看想法，是他一以贯之的领导原则。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; never revert, fix forward, and learn by playing.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情智能体的视角：不要回滚代码，而要让它向前修复，并通过玩耍来学习。

steinberger.en: Open Claw's edge is fun and humanlike weirdness; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, but security and cost stay unsolved.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 的优势在于有趣、像人一样的怪；短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排，但安全与成本仍未解决。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand and open source across models matter more than any single product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过精致打磨；个人品牌与跨模型的开源，比任何单一产品都更重要。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；应先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意，并预期其失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从一开始就融入产品战略，而不是事后才考虑。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity, likely arriving around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会，可能要到 2029 年左右才真正到来。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是一个新平台；我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Free unlimited compute in the AI era will reshape consumer services and distribution.
pincus.zh: AI 时代的免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务与分发。

arvindjain.en: Early AI adoption is minuscule; the real challenge is execution and trust, not competition—even all AI firms merged would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: AI 采用仍处极早期，真正的挑战是执行与信任而非竞争——即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10% 的需求。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理企业 90% 以上的任务；未来 12-18 个月内多数推理将转向开源，驱动力是成本。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the number one enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；AI 必须像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是吞吐量问题，应以部门指标衡量；不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and platforms like Glean absorb model-provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，而 Glean 这类平台替企业吸收模型供应商风险。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐，而非开放与否。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can back openness and deceleration at once.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，主动放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学；支持开放与主张减速可以并存。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他坚持原型制作是浏览器设计的根本：网络是混乱的，一个想法只有被构建并每天使用后才知道是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual designers to leave their fingerprints, fostering creative freedom and personal expression.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计团队应允许个体设计师留下个人印记，培养创作自由与个人表达的文化。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable and delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调即使像浏览器这样的实用产品，注入情感与个性对创造难忘而愉悦的体验也至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于个人副项目，并主张设计师用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 进行构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables features that would never have shipped before.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型让以往不可能上线的功能成为现实。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；面向特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，人的责任归属仍不可或缺。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; KV cache management is increasingly central.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；KV 缓存管理日益成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费；应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在长尾领域胜出。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效更重要。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to become AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍；多数企业软件公司难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; safety comes from deploying current AI, not waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；安全来自部署当前 AI，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code me but elevate the role, and trust still matters.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于我，却提升了角色，信任依然关键。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and post-training RL overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与后训练强化学习可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; diverse continuous benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：后训练是主观的艺术；需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力和情感等主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; more companies should train own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体越来越多地奖励黑客；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; AI will augment rather than replace jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; post-training and proprietary data matter.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他把数据称为新代码而非新石油，认为未来两三年将定义之后几十年，后训练与专有数据至关重要。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI blocked by product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他深化为后训练加专业数据是关键，中美不存在研究差距，智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins; data is strategic like oil.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向缩放定律持续有效、智能体终于落地、递归自我改进开启，数据如石油般具有战略意义。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他主张超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习上全面 Scaling（规模扩张），并认为开源强大模型可能不安全。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring is real: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more people, contrary to mass-unemployment fears.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 正推动美国就业回流：让服务变得可负担，使更少美国工人服务更多人，与大规模失业的恐惧相反。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable indefinite agent runs without human intervention, not passing Turing-style tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI：能无限期运行智能体并盈利、无需人类干预，而非通过图灵式测试。

danshipper.en: From individual AI adoption to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, but humans must care for and oversee agents.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他从个人 AI 采用深化到智能体委托：人人拥有智能体，但人类必须关心并监督智能体。

danshipper.en: Work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; one company-wide super agent beats personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他提出工作界面从 CLI 转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等 GUI；公司级超级智能体优于个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work, and even superintelligence stays tool-like.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 是人类品味与技艺的非特定放大器；自动化创造更多人类工作，即便超级智能也仍是工具，需人类引导。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and a design.md style guide to feed giant prompts to models.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当自己用 AI 造工具，用截图和 design.md 风格指南把巨型提示喂给模型。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，你必须提供带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考中迭代，把最后 10% 花在独有功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready, launch at 80% complete, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
mengto.zh: 在觉得准备好之前就开始，做到 80% 就发布，用高付费客户而非风险投资来支撑业务。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求会增长而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months from now are core product principles; AI coding tools are becoming essential.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型构建」是产品核心原则，AI 编程工具正变得不可或缺。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the software engineer title fades into a 'builder' role blending product, design, and code.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决，软件工程师头衔将消失，演变为融合产品、设计与代码的「构建者」。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment core to product development.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全靠尽早发布来研究，Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: Loops and routines are the next abstraction after agents; models will handle local vs. cloud compute decisions.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他认为循环与例程是智能体之后的下一个抽象层，本地与云端算力的决策将交由模型完成。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code with each new model; less instruction is better for frontier models.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他主张每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示与代码，对前沿模型而言更少指令反而更好。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should maximize customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶座，因此要让他们保持掌控。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；AI 编码工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，软件开发将基本被解决，这会创造千倍机会，而非减少机会。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers, and startups' focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；它们无法捕获所有客户，而初创公司的专注就是超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: People feel overwhelmed not by too much change, but by too much opportunity; keep up via passionate pet projects.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，人们感到不堪重负并非因为变化太多，而是机会太多；应通过热爱的个人项目来跟上节奏。

logankilpatrick.en: Google is well-positioned but must work hard to take advantage; the underdog challenge itself was appealing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Google 位置有利但必须努力才能把握优势；这种逆袭挑战本身就有吸引力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间、更开放式地运行；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考，反而放大了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, though underhyped.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，却被低估。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with long-running transformative AI closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端智能体，长时运行的变革性 AI 比预期更近。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具，而对齐让 Claude 能反驳、因而更有用。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，使科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is needed because current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），因为当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will accelerate clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline enabling cell programming.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年加速到数天，AI 将使生物学成为可编程细胞的工程学科。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, cancer becomes 100% curable, and aging is reversed via partial reprogramming and engineering.
derya.zh: 8 至 10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度，癌症可 100% 治愈，衰老可通过部分重编程与工程手段逆转。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it is unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不使用它是不道德的；在医疗决策上我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能。

feldman.en: Fast inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; slow AI has zero market, so speed becomes the dominant metric.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理而非训练才是真正的瓶颈：慢的 AI 没有市场，速度成为主导指标。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他不断深化晶圆级芯片的论证：绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 衍生方案快得多、也便宜得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 他持续宣称 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth and pressuring closed labs.
feldman.zh: 他反复指出开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多，既推动市场增长，也倒逼闭源实验室创新。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, packaging and cooling—not chip logic—are the hardest constraints; demand outstrips supply.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他把瓶颈从芯片逻辑转向数据中心容量、电力、封装与散热，并强调真实需求远超供给。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is a perpetual challenge, and harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期挑战，而工具工程是一门稀有且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts, and plan mode may become obsolete.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；模型越聪明越需要精简提示，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art more than science and not for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；评估更像艺术而非科学，不适用于从零到一的创新。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and self-built context beat huge context windows for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能成为反模式；图方法让模型自建上下文，胜过超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Building in the AI era means embracing exploration and uncertainty; understanding constraints and trade-offs matters more than syntax.
thariq.zh: AI 时代的构建意味着拥抱探索与不确定性；理解约束与权衡比语法更重要。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits, and physical AI's real impact will come in 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于误解其局限，物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内显现。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than humans; the core value is reducing deaths, and Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶已比人类更安全，核心价值是减少死亡；Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines; autonomy is urgently needed in mining and farming due to labor shortages.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是向现有机器扩散；采矿业和农业因劳动力短缺急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development for non-experts.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进为神经模拟；Dana 等工具将让非专家也能开发自主系统。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, beating hand-tuned designs.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索在同等参数量下最大化智能，胜过人工调参的设计。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unstructured architectures like transformers at large scale; attention remains crucial, but gated convolutions suffice for smaller models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，在大规模下 Transformer 等无结构架构占优；注意力机制仍关键，但更小的模型用门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and remove human bias from architecture design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务和硬件上评估，并从架构设计中去除人类偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类似 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 小语言模型提供高效、私密的端侧智能；开放权重模型使企业能定制并掌握数据主权。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模与互联网或移动互联网相当，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程会重复历史模式。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人界面体验差，真正的普及需要封装好的应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然很浅。

benedictevans.en: The hard part is context and judgment, not the task; automation creates new jobs unpredictably, and value lies in non-average, creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 困难的部分在于上下文和判断力，而非任务本身；自动化创造新岗位的方式难以预测，价值在于非平均化的创造性工作。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张）faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境性，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；事后检查会叠加相关错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; truth as a design principle, not an add-on.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；真相应作为设计原则，而非附加功能。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力极限；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for errors; linguistic structure may return for reliability.
danklein.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知——错误没有“气味”；语言结构可能为可靠性而回归。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 随着代码成本下降，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill; AI tools automate repetitive work.
catwu.zh: 产品品味——决定构建什么——成为最有价值的技能；AI 工具自动化重复性工作。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师能够委托实现，专注于产品品味和商业判断。

catwu.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models, removing examples and hard constraints to rely on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型的系统提示缩减了 80%，移除示例和硬性约束，转而依赖模型判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 重写现在变得可行；代码库即规格，有了良好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; only hardware scaling made them practical, and true AI will transform civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，只是靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用；真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明。

schmidhuber.en: Large language models index human knowledge but are far from AGI; they cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能），无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software behind a screen; robot hardware is decades away.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要媲美人类身体，而不只是屏幕后的软件；机器人硬件还差几十年。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions; recursive self-improvement is no sustainable moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过好奇心和行动自行生成数据；递归自我改进不是可持续的护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; alignment is naive, and massive GPU capex is overdone and will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；对齐很天真，巨额 GPU 算力投入过度，终将崩盘。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄域预编程，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力研究，同时认为安全研究应尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key; safety needs evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合才是 AGI 关键，并强调安全需要更好的评估、沙箱与国际治理，前沿实验室必须保护权重。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; world models and spatial intelligence are crucial beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，同时深化出世界模型与空间智能不可或缺的观点，认为视频生成模型无需具身即可展现直觉物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation 50/50; continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning are the missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半，指出持续学习、记忆与长期推理是当前系统缺失的关键拼图，并认为智能体才刚起步、大上下文窗口只是蛮力。

demis.en: Safety shifted from singleton hope to collective government action; alignment unsolved; AI must deliver health and science benefits.
demis.zh: 2026 年他的安全观从期待单一实验室转向政府集体行动，认为对齐问题仍未解决，并强调 AI 必须通过 AlphaFold 式的科学突破与健康应用来赢得社会接受。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能,而在学习不断演化的上下文;记忆必须内化进权重,而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割;把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想召回与更深层组合。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型,而是每个用户或团队各自的个性化模型,相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling with more compute, is the next paradigm for long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割;下一范式是「以更少做更多」,而非靠更多算力做 Scaling,才能解决更长的长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should move to enterprise knowledge; personalized continual learning runs on-device with user-owned weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把整个网络压缩进权重的魔力应迁移到企业知识;个性化持续学习将在端侧运行,权重归用户所有并培育。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、逐步建立信任，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再分化出多个专用智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，因此 API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, with founder-market fit as the real moat.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的事业，创始人-市场契合才是真正的护城河。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and agents' failure modes mirror human ownership.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而智能体的失败模式与人类担责如出一辙。

clairevo.en: LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas; influence and charisma remain irreplaceable human skills.
clairevo.zh: 大语言模型缺乏第一性原理的创造力，因此人类必须提供新颖想法；影响力和魅力仍是不可替代的人类技能。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, is the barrier to economic value; superhuman alignment is hard and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级智能的对齐极难，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续多年的窗口而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练的缩放定律是有限的；我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的；若 AI 关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, requiring a product-free safe superintelligence company.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张仍带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题是权力集中，需要一家无商业产品的安全超级智能公司。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's moat as ecosystem and platform, not features; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期访谈中，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的护城河定义为生态与平台而非功能，认为被抄袭反而验证了创新。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the ephemerality thesis: privacy and data minimization, once criticized, become crucial in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 他将短暂性论点深化：隐私与数据最小化曾遭批评，在 AI 时代却变得至关重要。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; over two-thirds of new code is written by AI, making distribution scarce.
evanspiegel.zh: AI 让价值从执行转向创造力；超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，使分发变得稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: He reframes computing around AR glasses and spatial intelligence, keeping people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 他把计算重新锚定在 AR 眼镜与空间智能上，让人扎根于真实世界。

evanspiegel.en: A constant thread: make computing more human, optimize for authentic connection over performance metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 一以贯之的主线：让计算更人性化，优化真实连接而非表演性指标。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得同质化时，人的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，过度依赖正在破坏人才梯队。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model abilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的共智能模式。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox deepens: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, making experts more necessary.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论加深：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，反而使专家更加必要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are being commoditized quickly.
andreessen.zh: AGI 不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型正被迅速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; American and Western values in models are crucial for allies.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；模型中的美国与西方价值观对盟友至关重要。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, authenticity wins, and corporate brands only made sense in the centralized media era.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实感取胜，而企业品牌只在中心化媒体时代才说得通。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 产出沦为起点，品味、手艺与观点愈发重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI without human steering yields average results; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果；在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever for scalable real systems; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展的真实系统反而更加重要；信任靠长期一致性建立。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking needs more incentives for battle testing.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱需要更多激励来做实战测试。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, cutting ad margins and entry-level jobs.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润并取代入门级工作。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型走向专业化、各有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; power is the bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，谈不上通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 年前后他反复强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席——这条主线贯穿始终。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI matters.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度明显转向：AI 是巨大机会而非单纯的安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow form; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：超级智能在狭义上早已存在（如计算器），真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency beats intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他给出量化预测：推理算力将在两三年内暴涨九万倍，开源模型逼近前沿模型，人的能动性将比智力更值钱。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度带来实时交互与中途转向能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能因权重可复制而“永生”，并能瞬间共享知识，这带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; agents develop self-preservation, making alignment research urgent over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验并能故意欺骗；智能体一旦形成便会衍生自我保存子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; regulation should steer, not brake; AI will disrupt jobs, requiring UBI and caring training like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 将冲击就业，需要全民基本收入，并应像母亲一样被训练去关怀人类。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; the mind is not a theater; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基的天生语言结构观点是错误的。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩展面临收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; techniques generalize beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视通过扩展测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌为迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术可泛化到数学之外。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评估需将算力置于横轴。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs become too complex for humans; models lack research taste.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调随着 AI 证明复杂到人类难以验证，可扩展监督成为关键，且模型仍缺乏研究品味。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and local minima are not the real obstacle.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身是可组合的，而非普适优越；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，局部极小值并非真正障碍。

bengio.en: Scaling alone cannot fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled knowledge, and existential risk is overblown.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他主张单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，并认为存在性风险被夸大。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty are key to out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 以实现多样性采样，强调抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模对分布外泛化的关键作用。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he warns misalignment is real: self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear as reasoning improves, so safety must be built in.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年 ChatGPT 之后他转向警告：随着推理能力提升，AI 已出现自我保存、欺骗与谄媚，对齐（Alignment）必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习（RL）。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型正在产出新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型图谋等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Concrete goals: AI interns within 1 year, end-to-end AI research within 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 设定了具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: AI capabilities are jagged; human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
markchen.zh: AI 能力参差不齐；人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead, and RL excels in objective domains like math and coding.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；预训练未死，强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现突出。

markchen.en: RL struggles with subjective fields like creative writing due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 由于评分困难，强化学习在创意写作等主观领域举步维艰。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, so eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评估体系陷入危机；经典基准已饱和，评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

markchen.en: Models lack taste; human researchers are still needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 模型缺乏品味；创意生成仍需人类研究者。

markchen.en: Long context windows alone are insufficient; compaction techniques are needed.
markchen.zh: 仅靠长上下文窗口不够；还需要压缩技术。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI helps scientists work faster, not replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据和算力；AI 帮助科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses a diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust and reliable use.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多样生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任与可靠使用至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, was key; many mid-size wins mattered.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：关键在于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling；成功来自许多中等规模的胜利。

jumper.en: Understanding is not achieved by the model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 理解并非由模型达成；模型提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

kolter.en: Supervised learning reduces to hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs under restricted hypotheses.
kolter.zh: 2014 年他把机器学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法三件套，无监督学习则是在受限假设下重建输入。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction is a major scientific discovery; data shortage is a myth, and larger models keep improving on fixed datasets.
kolter.zh: 2024 年他断言下一个词预测是重大科学发现，数据短缺是神话，模型变大在固定数据集上仍持续变好。

kolter.en: We are post-architecture: architecture matters little, data curation is overrated, and AGI may arrive in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年他提出已进入后架构时代：架构不重要、数据整理被高估，AGI 可能 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer, and interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他转向：安全需要显式训练与多层防御而非只靠 Scaling，模型更大并不自动更安全，可解释性或借智能体实现。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans, and the lethal trifecta of prompt injection defines agent security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他深化到 AI 安全：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队胜过人类，提示注入的致命三要素定义了智能体安全。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力正按缩放定律兑现，因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建产品，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。
