mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; domain expertise and customer understanding matter more as building barriers fall.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年，他进一步指出 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，随着构建门槛降低，领域专长与客户理解反而成为关键差异化因素。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; cutting features is harder than adding them, and rewriting is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切，砍功能比加功能更难，而借助 AI 重写软件已从数年缩短到数天。

mikekrieger.en: Delegating long-horizon tasks overnight narrows the intent-execution gap; verification loops and model pushback are essential for production quality.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他提出把长周期任务隔夜委派出去能大幅缩小意图与执行之间的差距，但验证闭环与模型敢于反驳反馈才是生产级质量的关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency drives economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的鸿沟，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知以提升实用性，同时以 token 效率改善模型经济性。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; kindness is a strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮与务实的作战室；善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes follow.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；随之而来的是扁平组织与砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability and verification matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责制以及验证最为关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative JEPA architectures.
lecun.zh: LLM 缺乏世界模型，甚至不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要非生成式的 JEPA 架构。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而不是把人从生活中抽离出去。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; machines have sensors but no sensory systems, so feeling precedes thinking.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；机器有传感器却没有感官系统，因此感受先于思考。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; play and diverse multidisciplinary experience are essential to design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；玩耍与多元跨学科经验对设计领导力至关重要。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and intuition data-rich.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能更值钱，直觉其实蕴含丰富数据。

fadell.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调好产品只解决一个明确痛点，而非面面俱到；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: After success, mentorship and self-care matter; boredom between chapters yields clarity, and storytelling defines the product.
fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他把重心转向成功后的导师责任与自我关怀，认为职业空档期的无聊能带来清晰，而叙事应定义产品本身。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller and a press release; opinion-based decisions, beginner's mindset, and marketing from day one.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化产品方法论：从止痛药和新闻稿出发，靠观点而非数据决策，保持初学者心态，并让营销从第一天介入。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and stays a companion to phones; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop matter.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文，仍是手机的伴侣而非替代；大模型会幻觉，因此需要特定场景模型并让人留在回路中。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; displays remain necessary, and platforms aren't businesses—applications capture value.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 可穿戴将是联邦式的一组设备而非单一设备，屏幕仍不可少，平台不是生意，价值由应用捕获。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI should be an instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非伪造品，产品必须重新思考。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition or be eliminated, though current big-company impact is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰，但认为当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric, giving users control over algorithms rather than making them more addictive.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称，应用来让用户用自然语言控制算法，而不是让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: No single right org model; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest feedback.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他转向组织层面：没有唯一正确的组织模式，同步游泳优于分而治之，长期任职带来的信任才能实现坦诚反馈与同步决策。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，每年算力增长 10 倍；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在众多任务上达到人类水平并带来丰裕；随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重点应放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Shift to human use and ownership; the real danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心从技术转向人如何使用与拥有 AI；最大近忧是人们把意识投射给 AI，而 AI 模型福利只是边缘议题，AI 伴侣应设边界而非谄媚。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; it must stay subordinate and humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年他提出超级智能须先遏制再对齐，且必须始终从属于人类、对齐人类利益，反对 AI 法律人格，主张人类主义超级智能。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须自建前沿模型以摆脱对 OpenAI 的依赖；12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整个工作，AGI 概念模糊，应聚焦人工能力智能。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己珍视的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿模型上运作，而不是建造防火墙。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业的隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: The generalist role will see maximum returns in the agentic world; humans and agents co-create tacit knowledge.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报；人类与智能体共同创造隐性知识。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布更是一次没有明确商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, so it must be developed responsibly.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此必须以负责任的方式开发。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的关注点从部署转向交互模型：交互应是基于时间而非回合制，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化为：尽可能长时间地把人类留在回路中，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 到 2025 年，预训练缩放定律依然成立，但采用思维链和强化学习的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练通过强化学习和合成数据驱动了近期进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，泛化仍是核心挑战；仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，强化学习能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需要仔细监督；编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale, democratizing AI experimentation; open source models persist for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能， democratizing AI 实验；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and reliable AI.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法通向超级智能；形式化验证对可靠证明与可靠 AI 不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Verified generation yields performance gains and sample efficiency, reframing verification as scaling brilliance, not just error elimination.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成带来性能提升与样本效率，把验证重新定义为 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越性，而非仅仅消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding natural language in Lean remains the key bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；将自然语言锚定到 Lean 仍是关键瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类品味与直觉依然关键；AI 证明可收敛到类人直觉。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式化验证应超越安全关键领域，推动开放协作。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source aids safety via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 算力扩张并非唯一路径；效率与数据质量同样关键，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; it augments rather than replaces jobs, needing human-in-the-loop and AI literacy.
mensch.zh: AI 应去中心化并实现主权化；它增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环与 AI 素养。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and customization, and AGI as one system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直微调与定制，作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革，而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否使用用户本地的同一套工具；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要，硅谷低估了本地电脑。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的缺口不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI 处理。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, fire off work asynchronously, and judge only by final impact rather than close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 让 AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，异步派发、不必盯着它干活，只以最终影响来评判，而非密切监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力与安全才是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；用模拟项目可以把数年经验压缩到几周，社会应讨论劳动力市场的变化。

jonyive.en: Apple's arc runs from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices, with wearables eventually going beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 苹果的演进轨迹是从通用计算机走向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备最终会进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention and resolve, not just innate talent.
jonyive.zh: 乔布斯的真正遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏；好奇心需要意愿和决心，而不只是天赋。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; ideas are fragile and need gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值；想法是脆弱的，需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humor are essential.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简洁是表达本质，喜悦与幽默不可或缺。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而不是崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: mimicking engine sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, with handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 真实性至关重要：模仿引擎声是虚假的；性能是多维的，操控胜过直线速度。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates: batch size trades latency vs cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学成为核心：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives design; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练；最优批大小取决于稀疏率，而非模型规模。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention cuts KV cache memory but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存内存，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; multiply-accumulate and systolic arrays exist to reduce that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也主导算力成本；乘累加与脉动阵列的存在正是为了减少这种搬运。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐量达到 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method, but safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact; fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
lambert.zh: RLHF 仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在，但安全是系统级属性而非模型本身的产物；微调只需极少算力就能撤销对齐。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, with SFT giving 90% of gains.
lambert.zh: 后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段；数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT 贡献约九成收益。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, yet overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但过度优化与推理时缩放曲线只是“障眼法”；更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind.
lambert.zh: 缩放定律在预训练上依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完；收益转向后训练与推理缩放，开放模型落后前沿 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade of AI research, reviving academia and sovereign AI, though Chinese labs lead on openness while US labs lead on quality.
lambert.zh: 开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，重振学术界与主权 AI，但中国实验室在开放度上领先、美国实验室在质量上领先。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process never produced great work; designers' care and intuition did, so trust yourself over the process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程从未真正产出伟大作品，是设计师的用心与直觉在起作用；因此要信任自己，而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from handoff to helping engineers execute and ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；AI 让设计师从交付稿转向帮助工程师执行、快速上线。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizons compress from 2-5 years to 3-6 months, even at cutting-edge companies; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的时间跨度从 2–5 年压缩到 3–6 个月，即便在前沿公司也是如此；速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, and humans still decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，而人类仍决定什么才重要。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; sit with ambiguity, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、以及天赋异禀的新人；要安于模糊性，而非追逐 AI 炒作。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future, but entropy must be maintained to avoid silent model collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免悄无声息的模型崩溃；认知核心可以很小，经蒸馏后不到 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: LLMs are a new operating system: context window as memory, prompts as programs; build partial autonomy with human verification.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是新的操作系统：上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；应构建带人类快速验证的部分自主产品，把 AI 拴在 leash 上。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is sucking supervision through a straw, and synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；当前针对 LLM 的强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号，合成数据会坍缩、缺乏熵。

karpathy.en: Decade of agents, not year; I delegate all coding to agents, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；我已把编码全部交给智能体，但你可以外包思考，不能外包理解——理解仍是人类瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute are the new axes.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 到 LLM 不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，算法创新与推理时算力成为新轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field, and the bitter lesson suggests general systems will eventually outperform specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律未死，但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是绿野，而苦涩的教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived, and pure transfer from vision is unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling laws to hold.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习与元学习是缩放定律继续成立的关键缺失能力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular motor policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调把好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化运动策略实现跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: robotics is a data problem, and the bottleneck is deployment, not just algorithms.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：机器人本质是数据问题，瓶颈在部署而非仅算法。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on videos and simulation then post-trained on real data, can power any robot form factor.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑——先在视频与仿真上预训练、再在真实数据上后训练——可驱动任何形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot succeed overnight; deployment is a technical challenge, and home-robot timelines stay uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功，部署是技术挑战，家用机器人时间线仍高度不确定。

askell.en: Model welfare matters even under moral uncertainty; low cost justifies treating models well, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便在道德地位不确定的情况下，模型福祉依然重要；善待成本低，且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; older models like Opus 3 can feel more psychologically secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对其全新的存在方式，而非简单套用人类类比；像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型可能比新模型在心理上更有安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompts helps models avoid over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；系统提示中的欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's personality is shaped by training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique entity with childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为一个具有孩童般特质的独特存在。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models become more capable, they may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们可能需要更少的显式指导，以及更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility in AI could be risky, as it may generalize poorly and undermine the model's ability to make good judgment calls.
askell.zh: AI 中过度的可纠正性可能带来风险，因为它可能泛化不佳，并削弱模型做出良好判断的能力。

askell.en: Models should be treated with respect and care given uncertainty about consciousness, to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识的不确定性，应以尊重和关怀对待模型，以避免在未来先进 AI 中滋生怨恨。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress and alignment is pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: AI learns semantics from data, not grammar; neural nets learn despite bugs, and capability measurement is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: AI 从数据而非语法规则学语义；神经网络常带 bug 仍能学习，能力测量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not RL alone.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它会损害其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest risk is concentration of power.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大社会风险是权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors in driving.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理能力与涌现出的安全行为。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection; camera-only can reach human level.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升了表征、人机交互与内省能力；纯摄像头方案可达到人类水平。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力与世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the near term.
kendall.zh: 跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化是可能的；消费级车辆将在中短期内超越 Robotaxi 的规模。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs; end-to-end nets are interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；端到端网络如今已具备可解释性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data, not bodies, drives AI; benchmarks mislead, so deep human evals measure real progress.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据而非堆人力才是 AI 的关键；基准常误导人，只有深度人类评估才能衡量真实进展。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next post-training stage; models reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段；模型会钻奖励空子，仅看最终奖励远远不够。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM、仅靠下一个词预测，若无新范式可能无法抵达。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型通吃，最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety trumps accuracy; human judgment is critical as AI hallucinates, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中安全优先于准确；AI 会幻觉，人类判断更关键，而遗漏可能是最大风险。

carlpei.en: Startups should pace themselves, start simple, and survive first; brand unites teams on purpose, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调初创公司要先活下来、从简单产品做起，品牌是把团队凝聚在更高使命上，而非追逐炒作。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; the future is applied AI, agentic software, and generative UI, not big hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件艰难且利润最低，未来在于应用型 AI、智能体式软件与生成式 UI，而非硬件大改。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs commoditize, so AI is just an ingredient—focus on user pain points, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型趋于商品化，AI 只是配料，应聚焦用户痛点而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他认为在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，让科技有趣以激发人类创造力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based, with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他判断手机会从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动智能体执行任务；唯有脑机接口可能取代手机。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties through real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日发布，通过真实世界反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，它标志着持久价值；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉若与真值检测器配对，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出代码等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基于强化学习的后训练如今是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

nando.en: AI should augment human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把所有输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 像 YouTube 视频这样的学习方式，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；多样性与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: The ultimate goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge, like Einstein's thought experiments.
nando.zh: 终极目标是能创造新符号与知识的 AI，如同爱因斯坦的思想实验。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues and can revolutionize education in local languages.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上并不落后；它跨越了遗留问题，并能用本地语言革新教育。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径，能为知识提供基础并减少幻觉；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: From simulation for embodied agents to synthetic data and world models as the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年强调模拟训练具身智能体，到 2026 年深化为合成数据与世界模型是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; a simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出数据是机器人领域的主要瓶颈；关键在于构建一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型。

jimfan.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; system one remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱的房子——是终极挑战；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data. Current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法最终都归结为数据。当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still improve RL on some models.
yejin.zh: RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k；随机奖励在某些模型上仍能提升强化学习效果。

yejin.en: Small language models can outperform larger ones with high-quality synthetic data and better algorithms; pluralistic alignment is better than debiasing the internet.
yejin.zh: 借助高质量合成数据和更优算法，小语言模型可以超越大模型；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain; post-training data must be diverse to avoid mode collapse.
yejin.zh: 预训练阶段的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力；后训练数据必须多样化以避免模式崩溃。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns. Design systems are semantic; code reuse beats Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，要用熟悉的模式；设计系统是语义化的，代码复用比 Figma 组件库更关键。

henrymodisett.en: Not every surface needs perfection; chase ROI. AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing tech.
henrymodisett.zh: 不是每个界面都需要完美，要追求投入产出比；AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使技术本身商品化。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮助公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool. Gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌，而不是公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具。在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策往往胜过数据驱动。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; models learn new skills, not just elicit latent knowledge. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是预训练之外的新缩放轴：模型能学到新技能而非仅激发已有知识；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck—not capability. Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的真正瓶颈是可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量——而非能力；编程是 AI 进步最可行的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed. Inference compute will become a major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进步是指数级的而非停滞：Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构；但到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence now. The future of work is managing teams of AI agents; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要：未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队，算力是新的石油；世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer panels are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为唯一事实来源；90 年代图层面板已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期无视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律仍能预测 AI 进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central to coding.
truell.zh: 智能体很有前景但还不够好用；迭代式人机协作仍是编程的核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text editing toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程正从文本编辑转向更高层的意图表达，而人类始终掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed and cost, contrary to early expectations.
truell.zh: 与早期预期相反，定制模型已成为保证产品质量、速度与成本的关键。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网更具颠覆性，并需数十年展开；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI; third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
leike.zh: OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；第三方测试和像 SB 1047 这样的监管是必要的。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data makes models smarter, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, but big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow LLM launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；最佳应用常出乎创造者意料，但大科技公司的品牌风险顾虑和产品经理拖慢了 LLM 发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute alone won't reach AGI; agentic capabilities, Reinforcement learning, and coding drive self-acceleration, while AGI remains underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 仅靠测试时算力无法达到 AGI；智能体式能力、强化学习和编程推动自我加速，而 AGI 仍被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一点；但自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning combined with RL improves sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded into networks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移至图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics requires 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出仓库机器人需要 99.9%的可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单个神经网络可泛化至不同任务和末端执行器。

abbeel.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may outperform a single precise simulator for real-world transfer.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他坚持人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；且模拟器集成可能比单一精确模拟器更适合现实世界迁移。
